compare_forecast_runs.description: See how the forecast for each hour has moved as that hour drew closer. For every hour it returns today's forecast beside the forecasts issued one, two and more days ago, plus a drift figure per variable: how much the outlook has shifted on average. Use it to tell a settling forecast from a wobbling one before committing to an outdoor booking, a delivery slot or a shutdown.

description: Look up the weather anywhere in the world through Open-Meteo's keyless API, across every dataset it publishes. Current conditions, forecasts by the 15 minutes, the hour and the day out to 16 days, and measured weather back to 1940. Ensemble forecasts that say how confident the outlook is, seasonal forecasts months ahead, and climate projections to 2050. Air quality and pollen, marine waves and swell, river discharge for flood watches, satellite measured solar irradiance, and ground elevation. Plus the archive of past forecasts, single model runs, and a geocoder for turning a place name into coordinates. No account or API key required.
